series: Baxi Duo-tec / Duo-tec 2 Combi GA Range (shared fault-code platform also used by Baxi EcoBlue, Platinum and Assure)
meaning: Interruption of gas supply or flame failure (ignition failure/flame not detected)

causes.cause: Gas supply interrupted or insufficient (meter valve left off, airlock after cylinder change, frozen condensate affecting operation, etc.)

checks.step: Check gas is on at the meter/valve and purge air from the supply
checks.expected: Gas present and stable at the burner

checks.step: Check supply pressure at the gas valve
Check the gas valve CO2 setting against the commissioning instructions
checks.expected: CO2% per gas type/model (see manual's commissioning section)

checks.step: Check ignition electrode, lead and connections for condition and correct spark gap/position
checks.expected: Electrode gap and position per manual diagram (approx. 4±0.5 mm at viewing window, 10±1 mm electrode position, 5±1 mm burner dimension - confirm exact dimension against the figure for your model)

checks.step: Check for spark at the ignition electrode (up to 5 seconds, 3 attempts)
Check flame sensing electrode and lead connections/position
checks.expected: Electrode clean, correctly positioned and connected

reset: Press the Reset button for 1 to 3 seconds to attempt to relight the boiler. If this does not work, or the code recurs regularly, further investigation per Section 17.2 'F'/'G' is required.
